listening.title: Suggesting an upgrade to a happy customer

lines.speaker: Thảo (Account Manager)
lines.text: Hi Mr. Đức, thank you for joining this quick call. How is the software working for you?

lines.speaker: Mr. Đức (Office Manager)
lines.text: Very well, thanks. My team uses it every day now.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Account Manager)
lines.text: I can see that. Your usage has grown a lot, and you are using ninety percent of your storage.

lines.speaker: Mr. Đức (Office Manager)
lines.text: Really? I didn't know that. What happens if we reach the limit?

lines.speaker: Thảo (Account Manager)
lines.text: You can't upload new files. But if you upgrade to the premium package, you get five times more storage.

lines.speaker: Mr. Đức (Office Manager)
lines.text: How much more would that cost us?

lines.speaker: Thảo (Account Manager)
lines.text: It's three dollars more per license each month. You also get the reporting feature set.

lines.speaker: Mr. Đức (Office Manager)
lines.text: That sounds useful. We're also hiring four new people next month.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Account Manager)
lines.text: Then I suggest adding four seats now. I can include them at the same price for the first three months.

lines.speaker: Mr. Đức (Office Manager)
lines.text: Okay, please send me a quote and I'll discuss it with my director.
